no: Let A′B′C′ be the Lucas(t) central triangle. Let L_{A} be the reflection of line B′C′ in line BC, and define L_{B}, L_{C} cyclically. Let A″ = L_{B} ∩ L_{C}, B″ = L_{C} ∩ L_{A}, C″ = L_{A} ∩ L_{B}. The triangle A″B″C″ is introduced here as the Lucas(t) reflection triangle. The Lucas(t) reflection triangle is perspective to ABC, the Lucas(u) central triangle, the Lucas(u) tangents triangle, the Lucas(u) inner triangle, and the Lucas(u) reflection triangle, for all t, u.
